record.dic_text:
06007 `Amacyah {am-as-yaw'}

源自 06006 和 03050; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Amasiah 1; 1

亞瑪斯雅 = "耶和華是有力量的"
1) 細基利的兒子, 猶大王約沙法時猶大廿十萬戰士的首領.  (#代下 17:16|)
record.edic_text:
06007 `Amacyah {am-as-yaw'}

from 06006 and 03050;; n pr m

AV - Amasiah 1; 1

Amasiah = "Jehovah is strength"
1) son of Zichri and captain of 200,000 warriors of Judah in the
   reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
